description.value: Sushi Mago is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Shelbourne Street in Victoria's Gordon Head neighbourhood. It operates as a compact sit-down and takeout spot, with online ordering available through its website. Cyclists exploring Victoria's east side residential corridors will find it a convenient stop for a Japanese meal.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 75m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is minimal but confirms the business name, address (4071 Shelbourne St #1, Victoria, BC V8N 5Y1), and phone number matching OSM. The website page title includes 'Order Online', providing positive evidence for takeout. No amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM address omits unit number (#1) and city; website version '4071 Shelbourne St #1, Victoria, BC V8N 5Y1' used as more complete. OSM does carry addr:unit=1 tag separately.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open sushi restaurant with confirmed address and phone. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in Victoria's east side.
